text: No, the whole property was not cleared in 2021. While there was tree-cover loss, it affected only about 2.23% of the asset (81.3 hectares out of 3,643.5 hectares). The loss was concentrated in planted forest areas (primarily *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with no evidence of large-scale clearing. Smaller patches (under 0.5 ha) accounted for an additional 37.3 ha but were not classified as significant events. The majority of the property remained unchanged.
